Back in September 2025, the launch of Hollow Knight: Silksong crashed the digital storefronts of Nintendo, PlayStation, Xbox, and Steam, as players who had waited over eight years for a follow-up to 2017's Hollow Knight rushed to download the highly anticipated sequel.

Star Wars Zero Company developer Bit Reactor has laid off an unspecified number of people

Bit Reactor furloughed "many of its workers" ahead of the release of the turn-based tactics game Star Wars Zero Company in August, before starting the process of returning furloughed staff to work in October. Now, it has emerged that an unspecified number of workers at the developer have been laid off.

German Games Industry Association warns the EU KIDS Act could undermine existing age-rating systems for video games

Game, the German Games Industry Association, has warned that the EU KIDS Act – which was unveiled in draft form in September and which is likely to have sweeping repercussions for game developers – could override well-established age-rating systems at the national level.
